tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: All tender conditions as per standard bid document
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnatak

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder Should quote rate per Kg of PAC powder inclusive of GST

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit Workdone Certificate/Experience Certificate For supply of PAC Poly Aluminium Chloride powder to any government departments for value not less than 47.50 lakhs as prime contractor for single supply work in last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. Work done shall be certified by Executive Engineer and above rank only. Work indent number must be mentioned.
The bidder should have supplied in any one year or continuous period of 12 months in the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 minimum 142400 Kg of PAC powder.

Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least two financial years minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 95.00 Lakhs in supply of Goods only, the turnover certificate should be certified by chartered accountant.
